definitions.explanation: The arrangement or sequence of things; one's turn in a sequence.

examples.japanese: {順|じゅん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}んで→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦あいうえお→あいうえお：noentry⟧{順|じゅん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{並|なら}べる→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧。

notes:
{順|じゅん} refers to order, sequence, or one's turn.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {順|じゅん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (in order, one by one)
- {順|じゅん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧ (to wait one's turn)
- ⟦あいうえお→あいうえお：noentry⟧{順|じゅん} (alphabetical order in Japanese)
- ⟦{年齢|ねんれい}→年齢：01490_nenrei⟧{順|じゅん} (in order of age)
- {順|じゅん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧ (to follow the order)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{順番|じゅんばん}→順番：03283_junban⟧: turn, order (more common in everyday speech)
- ⟦{順序|じゅんじょ}→順序：05460_junjo⟧: order, sequence (more formal)
- ⟦{順位|じゅんい}→順位：14679_juni⟧: rank, ranking
